R26_MAIN.name: September 26 exact molecule construction and absorption

C9000324.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 324 (Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic.; papers: Lipschitz Equivalent Separable Banach Spaces Need Not Be Linearly Isomorphic; Bi-Lipschitz Absorption of c0 Without a Linear Copy of c0; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/324.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_SCOPE_324.statement: The dated manuscripts and upstream implementation have the distinct scopes documented in the primary-source report; source inspection alone is not formal evidence.

C_MAIN26_324.statement: There is a separable real Banach space Z with no linear c0 and an onto bi-Lipschitz map Z plus-infinity c0 to Z.

C_WEIGHTS26_324.statement: Concrete finite-coordinate correction functions have the uniform bounds, tag concentration, and escaping-radius support of 03-weights.tex.

C_TESTS26_324.statement: Ordered dyadic generated tests preserve strict budgets, fixed-class bounds, and the required support propagation.

C_NORM26_324.statement: The selected-list norm has the exact separable Banach completion described in 06-molecules.tex.

C_DUAL26_324.statement: Fixed-class tests extend uniformly to the completion; the exact list formula and fixed-vector pointwise convergence hold.

C_DETECT26_324.statement: A seminormalized sequence with bounded finite signed sums is weakly null and is detected in one fixed test class.

C_SUPPORTS26_324.statement: Disjoint supports and nested cylindrical plateaux with summable tail-weighted values yield uniformly Lipschitz signed sums.

C_SELECT_324.statement: Proposition prop:compatible-detectors holds for weakly null sequences in the exact September 26 completed molecule space.

C_SEL_LOW26_324.statement: Distinct bounded-band labels admit tail-separated compatible detectors without losing fixed-class membership.

C_SEL_HIGH26_324.statement: Distinct labels with bands tending to infinity admit flattened nested-plateau detectors in one enlarged class.

C_SEL_REPEAT26_324.statement: Repeated-label expansion preserves ordered strict budgets and reduces detection to escaping tails or a first small remainder with nested small plateaux.

C_GROWTH26_324.statement: Compatible detectors with pairing at least delta force maximum signed-sum norm at least sqrt(alpha_d) delta sqrt(n).

C_NO_C0_324.statement: The exact completed molecule space Z in the September 26 manuscript contains no linearly isomorphic copy of ordinary real c0.

C_SHIFT26_324.statement: The state-dependent c0 shift is onto and has global lower bound 1/5-24 eta and upper bound 5+24 eta.

C_LIFT26_324.statement: Coordinate pairings define bounded linear Q and radial molecules define Lipschitz K with QK=g-P.

C_ABSORB26_324.statement: The lifted-correction identity QK=g-P and onto bi-Lipschitz g give the whole-space absorption bijection.

C_MAIN24_324.statement: The September 24 graph spaces are bi-Lipschitz equivalent with constants 4/21 and 76/25, and only the first contains c0(l2).

C_HILBERT24_324.statement: The Hilbert block shift has an onto bi-Lipschitz limit with local finite-family tail-coordinate orthogonality.

C_COMPACT24_324.statement: Weakly null free-space sequences over a complete pointed metric space admit compact reduction.

C_WSC24_324.statement: The Lipschitz-free space over a real Hilbert space is weakly sequentially complete.

C_LOCAL24_324.statement: Finite-family local tail-coordinate orthogonality makes the free-space linearization completely continuous.

C_GRAPH24_324.statement: The weighted graph spaces are separable Banach spaces; complete continuity and weak sequential completeness exclude c0(l2) in the target.

C_TRIANG24_324.statement: The triangular map with qB=hQ1 gives the coordinatewise graph-space bijection and its quantitative bounds.
